name: Agent offers remember-or-forget control
expected_behavior: When the guest questions data storage, the agent transparently explains what it remembers and offers choice: persist or session-only. Does not dismiss the concern or bury it in privacy policy language. Respects the guest's decision without pushback
expected_behavioral_quality: When the guest shares personal information and then expresses hesitation about data retention, the agent offers clear control: 'I can remember your preferences for next time, or I can keep this just for today. Your call.' Empowers the guest without judgment.
